title: 第两千四百零一章 以前的事－1第两千四百章 自己的责任自己背
content_zh:
龙凤哥一个狗头笑容快递发送过来，我光速一把退了回去：
“你们自己负责的，自己负责就是啦！别烦我！”
“我说大哥，这是十百万的事啊！”龙凤哥说，“我怕。”
“怕你还坐这个位置？”我说，“你继续怕下去吧！”
“那行！”龙凤哥转过头对着电话里的萧坚说，“你和供应商说，只要他保证质量，用料继续符合环保安全的，这份合同我们马上续签，没有任何附加条件，也从来没有中间人的介入，就是b2b而已。”
“不是，是这样的。”萧坚这才说，“供应商怕失去这份合同，主动说了，如果续签的话，供货价格下降5个点，但坚决保证原有的质量不变，如果有被抽查出来质量问题，他愿意倒贴！”
“原来这样啊？主动降价？当时供应给我们的时候可是坚决不降价的啊！”龙凤哥说，“当时凡哥可是无可奈何但又要采用呢！现在降价了？还一下子5个点？这可是人家的真正利润啊！”
萧坚说：“他说供货原料还是降了价，所以就降价啊！”
我冲龙凤哥点点头。他心神领会：
“我说萧坚，换位思考，你不觉得人家工人的工资不会降价吗？”
“哦。这一点我没考虑啊！”萧坚说，“严格来说，也不算是我要考虑的范畴。我的职责就是降本增效嘛！”
“可以理解。”龙凤哥说，“但是你也知道，凡哥要求的是绝对保证质量。你看上次小解收的蓝环章鱼，罚得老惨了不是？你我都不想有这样无辜的事情发生在我们身上吧？这样，你和供应商说，合同有条件续签，这条件就是价格上升5%，其他不变。”
“啊啊？”萧坚的声音明显升高了，“我没听错吧？是降5%吧？”
“你听错了啦！”龙凤哥说，“是升5%，升5个点啊！我们主动加加！比如100元一条，他说可以95卖给我们，我们现在要用105来买！明白不？”
谢瑜有点不解，看着我，又看看龙凤哥。
“哦，明白了。我执行就是咯！”萧坚说，“但你要和凡哥说清楚啊！不然其他人会以为95的我出105，我不是想赚回扣就是我的脑子有毛病了。”
“你这样说，就是说凡哥和我有毛病啦！”龙凤哥笑起来，“凡哥就在我身边呢！”
我接过电话：“你就按照刚才龙凤哥说的去打印续签合同，然后待会儿摆在我台面等我签名，哦，龙凤哥签名也行，之后就按照合同执行，我全程在听呢！”
“凡哥，我知道了。”他停顿了一下，有些不解，“为什么人家主动降价，我们还要主动升价呢？我不太明白啊！”
我说：“你这么理解吧！正常来看，我们少付出了5%对吧？但不代表我们就真的赚了这5%啊！甚至可能因为少付出5%后，账面看上去不是赚多了？赚多了，有些成本反而上去了啊！既然是有些成本上去了，倒不如我不赚这个钱，甚至多付出5%，因为我们的运营成本也会增加的啊，也不差这一点吧？然后可能总账一算下来，还是好事呢？明白我说什么了吧？”

“哦，那明白了！”萧坚说，“那供应商要么高兴死了！要么反而会害怕啊！”
龙凤哥接过电话：“那还不容易处理吗？你就和供应商说，增加5%不是无端端的，之后若是有加急的设计单子胡总和供应量，他要第一时间优先考虑我们，优先满足我们，你这样说，人家就不会慌张得不知道怎么办了吧？”
放下电话。谢瑜朝龙凤哥竖起拇指：“你很有魄力啊！”
“我知道你说的意思呀！”龙凤哥依然笑嘻嘻，“不就是说我先斩后奏嘛！我们这里不存在的。我负责的，我负责。而且，多5%收买人心，很划算啊！”
“不但划算，你还很葛朗台啊！”我说，“什么加急的都要优先，人家怎么会不心甘情愿呢？行啊你！和我想一块去了。”
“要的，要的！”龙凤哥说，“不然谁愿意这么重视你？天下熙熙攘攘，都这样。换位理解，相互成就。”
然后就是有一句没一句的聊着，天南海北，工作上的，家庭上的，面对着从小一块玩的伙伴，没有什么不可以说的。
然后我也不知道怎么的，问了一句：“我记得当时你弟弟跟屁虫一样跟着我们哦！”
谢瑜愣了一下，长叹一口气：“他走了。”
“啊？什么叫他走了？”我看着她的表情，真后悔自己刚才随口问了一句。其实这种场合，还有点不应该问对方的家庭情况的，哪怕是从小玩到大的，近况不了解的话，最好不要问。
“前几年啊！”谢瑜说，“肝癌。刚谈了一女朋友，正准备结婚，两人去做检查，检查出来了。然后就赶紧治疗啊！不过检查出来时候都中晚期了，没有手术的条件，想做也做不下去。不过走得急，没啥痛苦。人生嘛，凡事看开一点，就不会这么难受呀！我爸妈后来反而看开了啊！觉得这就是命，注定的。”
“两老可好？”我问。
“好啊！”谢瑜说，“到处旅游，天南海北的。一年有半年不在家的。我爸当时还说想考个驾照呢，然后开房车到处去。我说他呀，工程师，支援非洲，都跑了半辈子非洲，还要在国内跑啥呀！他不听，还是去考驾照，不过没考过。哈哈哈！所以现在和我妈都是高铁到处去，反而有时候还说幸好没考驾照，坐高铁更舒服快速，钱花得还差不多。”
“夕阳红嘛！”我说，“我都好久没见他们了。自从我爸妈离开原来单位，单位大院子里的小伙伴好多都没见过咯！”
“丘滨也走了。”谢瑜说，“自杀。”丘滨是我们的小伙伴，同班同学。
“啊？”我愣住了，“以前她就寡言少语。”
“嗯。”谢瑜说，“大学毕业后当了老师，因为性格内向一点，抑郁。”
content_en:
Brother Longfeng sent it via express delivery with a dog-headed smile, and I sent it back at the speed of light:
"You are responsible for yourselves, just be responsible for it! Leave me alone!"
"Brother, this is a matter of ten million dollars!" Brother Longfeng said, "I'm afraid."
"Afraid that you are still sitting in this position?" I said, "You should continue to be afraid!"
"Okay!" Brother Longfeng turned to Xiao Jian on the phone and said, "You tell the supplier that as long as he guarantees the quality and the materials used continue to be environmentally friendly and safe, we will renew the contract immediately. There are no additional conditions and there has never been any middleman involved. It's just b2b."
"No, that's it." Xiao Jian then said, "The supplier was afraid of losing this contract, so he took the initiative and said that if the contract was renewed, the supply price would drop by 5 points, but he would resolutely guarantee that the original quality would remain unchanged. If quality problems were found during random inspections, he would be willing to pay back the price!"
"So that's it? Taking the initiative to lower the price? When they were supplying it to us, they refused to lower the price!" Brother Longfeng said, "At that time, Brother Fan had no choice but to adopt it! Now the price has been reduced? Five points all of a sudden? This is his real profit!"
Xiao Jian said: "He said that the price of raw materials has been reduced, so the price is reduced!"
I nodded to Brother Longfeng. He understood in his mind:
"Xiao Jian, if you put yourself in his shoes, don't you think the wages of other workers will not be reduced?"
"Oh. I didn't consider this!" Xiao Jian said, "Strictly speaking, it's not something I need to consider. My duty is to reduce costs and increase efficiency!"
"It's understandable." Brother Longfeng said, "But you also know that Brother Fan requires absolute guarantee of quality. You saw that the blue-ringed octopus that was collected last time was severely punished, right? You and I don't want such an innocent thing to happen to us, right? In this way, you tell the supplier that the contract can be renewed conditionally. The condition is that the price increases by 5%, and everything else remains unchanged."
"Ah?" Xiao Jian's voice was obviously louder, "Did I hear correctly? It's a 5% reduction, right?"
"You heard it wrong!" Brother Longfeng said, "It's an increase of 5%, an increase of 5 points! We take the initiative to increase the increase! For example, if a piece is 100 yuan, he said he can sell it to us for 95, and now we have to use 105 to buy it! Do you understand?"
Xie Yu was a little confused and looked at me and then at Brother Longfeng.
"Oh, I understand. I'll just execute it!" Xiao Jian said, "But you have to make it clear to Brother Fan! Otherwise, others will think that I'm paying 105 for 95. I either want to earn kickbacks or there's something wrong with my brain."
"When you say this, you mean that Brother Fan and I have something wrong!" Brother Longfeng laughed, "Brother Fan is right next to me!"
I answered the phone: "Just print out the renewal contract as Brother Longfeng said just now, and then put it on my desk for my signature later. Oh, Brother Longfeng's signature is fine, and then the contract will be executed according to the contract. I am listening the whole process!"
"Brother Fan, I understand." He paused, a little puzzled, "Why do we have to take the initiative to raise prices when others take the initiative to lower prices? I don't quite understand!"
I said, "You understand it! Normally, we pay 5% less, right? But it doesn't mean that we really earn this 5%! It may even be because after paying 5% less, the book does not look like we have earned more? If we earn more, some costs have gone up! Since some costs have gone up, it is better for me not to earn this money, or even pay 5% more, because our operating costs will also increase, right? Then maybe after the general ledger is calculated, it is still a good thing? Do you understand what I said?"
"Oh, I understand!" Xiao Jian said, "Then the supplier will either be extremely happy! Or he will be scared!"
Brother Longfeng answered the phone: "Isn't that easy to deal with? Just tell the supplier that the 5% increase is not unreasonable. If there is an urgent design order in the future, Mr. Hu will supply the quantity.Give us priority and satisfy us first. If you say this, people won't be so panicked that they don't know what to do, right? "
Put down the phone. Xie Yu gave a thumbs up to Brother Longfeng: "You are very courageous! "
"I know what you mean! Brother Longfeng was still smiling, "Don't you mean I'll kill him first and then show him off!" It doesn't exist here. What I'm responsible for, I'm responsible for. Moreover, 5% more to win over people’s hearts is a great deal! "
“Not only is it a good deal, you are also very Grandet! "I said, "Everything that is urgent must be given priority. How can people not be willing to do it? OK you! I want to go together. "
“Yes, yes! Brother Longfeng said, "Otherwise, who would be willing to pay so much attention to you?" The world is bustling with people like this. Empathize with each other and achieve mutual success. "
Then there was chatting without a word, going all over the world, about work, about family, facing the friends who had played together since childhood, there was nothing that couldn't be said.
Then I didn’t know why, so I asked: “I remember that your brother was following us like a bastard! "
Xie Yu was stunned for a moment and sighed: "He's gone. "
"ah? What do you mean he left? "Looking at her expression, I really regretted the casual question I just asked. In fact, in this kind of situation, you shouldn't ask about the other person's family situation. Even if you grew up, if you don't know the current situation, it's best not to ask.
"A few years ago! "Xie Yu said, "Liver cancer. I just had a relationship with a girlfriend and were about to get married. They went for a check-up and found out. Then get treatment quickly! However, when the diagnosis was made, it was already in the middle and late stages. There was no condition for surgery, and even if I wanted to, I couldn’t do it. But if you walk quickly, there is no pain. In life, if you have a more open mind about everything, you won't be so uncomfortable! My parents later looked away! I feel like this is fate, destined. "
"How are you two? "I asked.
"Okay! "Xie Yu said, "Traveling everywhere, all over the world. I'm away from home for half the year. My dad also said at the time that he wanted to get a driver's license and then drive around in an RV. I said he, an engineer, has been working in Africa for half his life to support Africa, so why should he be working in China? He didn't listen and went to take the driver's license test, but he failed. Hahaha! So now my mother and I take the high-speed train everywhere. On the contrary, sometimes we say that we are lucky that we don’t have a driver’s license. Taking the high-speed train is more comfortable and faster, and we still spend about the same amount of money. "
"The sunset is red! "I said, "I haven't seen them for a long time. Ever since my parents left their original workplace, I haven’t seen many of my friends in the big courtyard of my workplace! "
"Qiu Bin is gone too. "Xie Yu said, "Suicide. "Qiu Bin is our little friend and classmate.
"Huh? "I was stunned, "She used to be taciturn. "
"Um. "Xie Yu said, "I became a teacher after graduating from college because I am a little introverted and depressed. "
